comparison.objective: Commission and lock a damper, versus test phone power buttons and sort phones by observed response.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires small-tool insertion, bounded torque, fine adjustment, and repeated physical-response interpretation; record requires timed button holds, observation, pick-and-place, and sorting.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two cycles satisfying travel, force, rebound, and drift limits. Record requires three-second button tests and correct tray assignment based on screen response.
comparison.reason: Both condition later actions on observed outcomes, but phone classification does not test mechanism adjustment, setting reacquisition, or physical dynamic commissioning. The record body omits tray-placement tolerances.
